q0AnchorReason: Reads no q0. The eps_m relocation is pure algebraic number theory in Z/5^W and the divisor lattice of 24; the substrate modulus never enters, and no pyhecke/Gram/Markov import exists in the cone.
source: CGZ arXiv:1712.04887v3 Remark 1.9 (p. 8), Lemma 2.3 and Lemma 2.4(a),(d),(e) (pp. 9-10); Addenda 27-31 (this repo)
scope: scope-(a) RELOCATION of the target, not a value. CGZ Remark 1.9 puts the invariant in (F_n^x/(F_n^x)^n)^{chi^{-1}} -- the chi^{-1}-eigenspace of F_n = F(zeta_n) -- with P_zeta in H^x/H^{xn} only its image. An eigenspace is proper only when F does not contain mu_n; every field in my programme was Q_5(mu_{624m}), which does, so the condition of Lemma 2.4(e) was vacuous throughout. The alpha-line field K = Q(alpha), alpha^3 - alpha^2 + 1 = 0, has two places over 5: at v_1 (degree 1) K_v = Q_5 lacks mu_3 and F_3 = Q_25, giving Gal = Z/2 and an eigenspace of order 3 inside a group of order 9 -- non-vacuous, with 5 a witness outside it; at v_2 K_v = Q_25 already contains mu_3 and collapses. This REVERSES half of Addendum 31: B = Q_25 is not 'too small', it is exactly F_n at v_1, and my chi_B = teich(.)^8 is exactly the eigenspace projection. What failed at the B level was the lift of P_zeta from H to F_n -- the step Remark 1.9 flags as unchecked -- not the choice of field. Separately, Lemma 2.3 is an isomorphism F^x/F^{xn} = H^1(Phi, mu), so the Kummer-cocycle reformulation computes the same object as Addendum 31 and is not a new route; no probe was spent on it. No eps_m value is claimed at m >= 3; the m = 2 result of PR #4968 is untouched.
